title: pfl.annotation/1
description: Annotation of one pen recording by one annotator (InkLab, V0.9): <recording>.pfl.jsonl.gz.ann.<annotatorId>.json next to the recording (an older <recording>.pfl.jsonl.gz.ann.json is read as the file of the author named inside). NUMBERING: stroke and sample numbers follow indexing 'inkattempt-after-last-restart' = PenLog.ToInkAttempt() with its default: only strokes started after the last restart-button event, from 0; samples inside a stroke are contact samples in order (hover is not counted). The recording is identified by penlogSha256 (SHA-256 of the UNcompressed JSONL, lowercase hex); strokes[] and the t of every point (PenSample.TimeUs, microseconds from task start) let a reader detect a changed recording. MAIN TRACE: all strokes except 'deferred' ones, in writing order. JUNCTION CONVENTION: junction k lies between letters k and k+1; 'end' is where the BODY of the left letter ends (the exit of the glyph), 'start' is where the BODY of the right letter begins (the entry of the glyph; for t - the top of the up-stroke); the stretch end..start is the connecting stroke (end = start when there is none). kind 'connected' means end and start are in ONE stroke; 'lifted' means a pen lift of the main trace lies between them (end.stroke < start.stroke, no main stroke in between); the points may be anywhere inside their strokes. The body of letter k runs from start of junction k-1 (first letter: from the start of the main trace) to end of junction k (last letter: to the end of the main trace). 'deferred' strokes (dots, crossbars) are not part of the main trace; their 'timing' is DERIVED from stroke order (immediate = some main stroke is written after it) and stored; 'timingOpinion' is present only when the annotator disagrees. Cross-field rules (junction count = letters - 1, monotone boundaries, hash and point times match the recording, deferred warnings) are checked by AnnotationValidator in Tools.InkLab, not by this schema. Unknown properties are rejected; another version needs another schema id.

penlog.description: File name of the recording, without a path (informational).

target.description: task.target of the recording, e.g. word:at.

variant.description: Variant of the task: lift, joined, dot.

text.description: What was actually written: letters in order, no spaces.

strokes.description: The strokes of the recording at annotation time.

t0.description: Time of the first sample, microseconds.

t1.description: Time of the last sample, microseconds.

after.description: Junction between letters after and after + 1.

t.description: Time of the sample, microseconds from task start.
